property_summary: For any caller X and any account Y != X, c.renounceRole(role, Y) called by X must revert (AccessControlBadConfirmation), while renounceRole(role, X) succeeds; the mutant removes the caller-confirmation check so such a cross-account renounce silently succeeds (never reverts), breaking the rule.
change_summary: Remove the caller-confirmation check so any account can renounce any other account's role.
